title: New FPS game MECHBREAKER I just created using AI
author: onelittledragon
selftext:
MECHBREAKER — Steel breaks. You don’t.

One pilot. Five occupied sectors. An army of machines standing in your way.

MECHBREAKER is a single-player sci-fi combat game that combines explosive firefights with tactical field operations. Battle Helix’s war machines across cargo docks, industrial foundries, neon streets, desert canyons, and a frozen research station. Customize four weapons, choose your chassis, and exploit enemy weak spots to bring towering machines down.

Enter Sector 9, where preparation can turn the fight in your favor. Gather intelligence, hack terminals, evade searching patrols, and plot your approach with the ATLAS tactical map. Ride the moving monorail, strike ARCHON-9, and reach extraction.

Build your inventory with repair kits, shield cells, EMP pulses, and decoys. Trade with Dark Web contacts, purchase mission intel, and take on generated recon, recovery, sabotage, and command-strike contracts. Bring your salvage home to fund the next deployment—or experiment with mission presets in the Game Master sandbox.

Play offline in your browser with keyboard, mouse, or controller.

[https://mechbreaker-vercel.vercel.app/](https://mechbreaker-vercel.vercel.app/)

Free to play.  Give me your feedback so I can make improvements.  Game was created using GTP6.1 Sol Ultra.
